blocks.zh: 玻璃容器檢測方法
blocks.en: Glass Container Inspection Method

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 瞭解空玻璃容器目視檢查方法的標準化需求，特別是 RTU（即用型）容器的重要性
blocks.en: Understand the need to standardize visual inspection methods for empty glass containers, particularly the importance of RTU (ready-to-use) containers

blocks.zh: 掌握檢查工作站設備要求、光源強度及背景設置的關鍵參數
blocks.en: Master the key parameters for inspection station equipment, light intensity, and background setup

blocks.zh: 理解檢測機率（Probability of Detection, PoD）的概念，以及粒子大小、形狀與材質對偵測率的影響
blocks.en: Understand the concept of Probability of Detection (PoD) and the effect of particle size, shape, and material on detection rate

blocks.zh: 學習跨產業研究的設計與統計分析方法，以及如何將結果應用於檢查員資格確認
blocks.en: Learn the design and statistical analysis of the cross-industry study, and how to apply the results to inspector qualification

blocks.zh: 掌握歸一化粒子尺寸（Normalized Particle Size）與形狀因子（Shape Factor）的計算概念
blocks.en: Grasp the concepts behind calculating Normalized Particle Size and Shape Factor

blocks.zh: 5.0 Glass Container Inspection Method 5.0 玻璃容器檢驗方法
blocks.en: 5.0 Glass Container Inspection Method

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: RTU Container（即用型容器）：指已經過清洗、滅菌處理，可直接用於充填的容器。由於不會再經過額外的清洗步驟，容器上任何殘留的可見微粒都可能直接進入最終產品，因此進料前的檢查至關重要。
blocks.en: RTU Container (ready-to-use container): A container that has already been washed and sterilized and can be used directly for filling. Because there is no further washing step, any visible particle remaining on the container may go straight into the final product, so incoming inspection is critical.

blocks.zh: 統計有效樣本（Statistically Valid Sample）：從大批次中抽取具有統計代表性的樣本數量，確保檢查結果能合理推論整批品質。這與 AQL（Acceptable Quality Limit）抽樣概念相關。
blocks.en: Statistically Valid Sample: A sample size drawn from a large batch that is statistically representative, so that the inspection results can reasonably be used to draw conclusions about the whole batch. This relates to the AQL (Acceptable Quality Limit) sampling concept.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像你在高級餐廳用餐前，服務生端上的餐具如果是「免洗型」（用完即丟），你會期望它開封即乾淨，不需要再擦拭。RTU 容器就像這樣的免洗餐具 -- 既然下游不再清洗，上游的品質把關就必須更嚴格。而目前業界對「怎麼檢查這些空容器」還沒有統一標準，這正是 TR85 要解決的問題。
blocks.en: Imagine that before a meal at a high-end restaurant, the server brings you disposable tableware (use once and discard). You would expect it to be clean the moment it is unwrapped, with no need to wipe it. RTU containers are like this disposable tableware: since nothing downstream will clean them again, quality control upstream has to be stricter. And the industry does not yet have a unified standard for how to inspect these empty containers, which is exactly the problem TR85 sets out to solve.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 本節開宗明義指出產業現狀的關鍵缺口：沒有統一的空玻璃容器檢查方法。這意味著不同藥廠、不同玻璃供應商的檢查標準可能差異很大，導致品質基準不一致。TR85 的核心價值就是提出一套經過跨產業驗證的標準化方法。
blocks.en: This section opens by pointing out the key gap in current industry practice: there is no unified method for inspecting empty glass containers. This means the inspection standards of different pharmaceutical companies and glass suppliers may differ widely, leaving no consistent quality baseline. The core value of TR85 is to propose a standardized method validated across industries.

blocks.zh: 檢查可以由玻璃製造商/轉換商或藥廠執行 -- 這是一個供應鏈責任分工的議題，需要在品質協議中明確定義。
blocks.en: Inspection may be performed by the glass manufacturer/converter or by the pharmaceutical company. This is a question of dividing responsibilities along the supply chain and must be clearly defined in the quality agreement.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼 RTU 容器的進料檢查比傳統容器更為重要？如果省略這個步驟，可能造成什麼後果？
blocks.en: Why is incoming inspection of RTU containers more important than for conventional containers? What could happen if this step were omitted?

blocks.zh: 在你的工廠中，空玻璃容器的檢查是由供應商還是由藥廠內部執行？責任如何在品質協議中定義？
blocks.en: In your facility, is inspection of empty glass containers performed by the supplier or in-house by the pharmaceutical company? How is the responsibility defined in the quality agreement?

blocks.zh: 5.1 Inspection of Ready-to-Use Empty Glass Containers 5.1 即用型空玻璃容器之檢驗
blocks.en: 5.1 Inspection of Ready-to-Use Empty Glass Containers

blocks.zh: Manual Visual Inspection, MVI（人工目視檢查）：由受過訓練的人員以肉眼判斷容器是否合格的檢查方法。這是一個「機率性」過程 -- 偵測率不可能達到 100%，因為人眼有其生理極限。
blocks.en: Manual Visual Inspection, MVI: An inspection method in which trained personnel judge by the naked eye whether a container is acceptable. It is a "probabilistic" process: a detection rate of 100% cannot be achieved because the human eye has physiological limits.

blocks.zh: 藥典方法基礎：本方法以三大藥典（EP、USP、JP）的已充填容器檢查條件為基礎，調整應用於空容器。這確保了方法的法規認可性。
blocks.en: Pharmacopeial basis: This method is based on the inspection conditions for filled containers in the three major pharmacopeias (EP, USP, JP), adapted for use with empty containers. This gives the method regulatory credibility.

blocks.zh: Seeded Defect Kit（植入缺陷測試套組）：在已知乾淨的容器中人為放入特定大小和類型的粒子，用於評估檢查方法的偵測能力和檢查員的資格確認。
blocks.en: Seeded Defect Kit: A test kit in which particles of specific sizes and types are deliberately placed into containers known to be clean, used to evaluate the detection capability of the inspection method and to qualify inspectors.

blocks.zh: MVI 就像機場安檢的 X 光檢查員 -- 即使是訓練有素的專業人員，面對大量行李時也不可能 100% 抓到每一件違禁品。疲勞、注意力分散、物品隱藏位置等因素都會影響偵測率。這就是為什麼要設定最長連續檢查時間（1小時）、要求定期休息、控制環境光線等條件 -- 所有措施都是為了將人為變異降到最低。
blocks.en: MVI is like an X-ray screener at an airport: even a well-trained professional facing a large volume of luggage cannot catch every prohibited item 100% of the time. Fatigue, distraction, and where the item is hidden all affect the detection rate. This is why conditions such as a maximum continuous inspection time (1 hour), required regular breaks, and controlled ambient lighting are set. All of these measures aim to minimize human variability.

blocks.zh: Table 5.1-1🔍 是本節最重要的參考表格，定義了五大關鍵屬性：
blocks.en: Table 5.1-1🔍 is the most important reference table in this section. It defines five key attributes:

blocks.zh: 檢查員：視力 20/20 或 6/6 以上，每兩年重新測試
blocks.en: Inspector: visual acuity of 20/20 or 6/6 or better, retested every two years

blocks.zh: 訓練與資格：使用含缺陷樣品的測試套組進行資格確認
blocks.en: Training and qualification: qualification using a test kit containing defective samples

blocks.zh: 環境：安靜、乾淨、降低環境光線
blocks.en: Environment: quiet, clean, with reduced ambient light

blocks.zh: 設備：2,000-3,750 lux 光源 + 黑白背景
blocks.en: Equipment: 2,000-3,750 lux light source + black and white backgrounds

blocks.zh: 方法：無放大、每面約 5 秒、距眼 30 cm、距光源 10-20 cm、旋轉檢視
blocks.en: Method: no magnification, about 5 seconds per side, 30 cm from the eye, 10-20 cm from the light source, with rotation of the container

blocks.zh: 這些數字是實務操作時的硬性要求，務必牢記。
blocks.en: These numbers are hard requirements in actual practice and must be remembered.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境中，你可能同時服務多個客戶、使用多種容器規格。建立標準化的檢查 SOP 時，Table 5.1-1🔍 的參數是最佳起點。特別注意：
blocks.en: In a CDMO environment you may serve several clients and use many container formats. When building a standardized inspection SOP, the parameters in Table 5.1-1🔍 are the best starting point. Pay particular attention to the following:

blocks.zh: 檢查員每兩年重新測試視力和資格，這需要納入人員訓練管理系統
blocks.en: Inspectors are retested for visual acuity and requalified every two years; this needs to be built into the personnel training management system

blocks.zh: 每小時不超過的連續檢查限制，需反映在排班計畫中
blocks.en: The limit on continuous inspection per hour must be reflected in shift scheduling

blocks.zh: 光源強度需要定期校驗並記錄 -- 這是稽核常見查核點
blocks.en: Light intensity must be verified and recorded periodically; this is a common audit checkpoint

blocks.zh: 為什麼人工目視檢查的偵測率不可能達到 100%？有哪些因素會影響偵測率？
blocks.en: Why can the detection rate of manual visual inspection never reach 100%? What factors affect the detection rate?

blocks.zh: Table 5.1-1🔍 中要求檢查員「每兩年重新測試」，你認為這個頻率是否足夠？為什麼文中提到這比已充填容器的檢查員要求頻率低？
blocks.en: Table 5.1-1🔍 requires inspectors to be "retested every two years". Do you think this frequency is sufficient? Why does the text note that this is less frequent than the requirement for inspectors of filled containers?

blocks.zh: 為什麼需要同時使用黑色和白色背景？各自適合偵測什麼類型的缺陷？
blocks.en: Why are both black and white backgrounds needed? What types of defects is each suited to detect?

blocks.zh: 5.1.1 Operator Training for the Enhanced Container Inspection Method 5.1.1 強化容器檢驗方法之操作員教育訓練
blocks.en: 5.1.1 Operator Training for the Enhanced Container Inspection Method

blocks.zh: Requalification Interval（再確認間隔）：空容器檢查員的再確認頻率為至少每兩年一次，比已充填容器的檢查員頻率低。原因是空容器後續還會在充填後再經過 100% 檢查和 AQL 抽樣，形成多重防線。
blocks.en: Requalification Interval: Inspectors of empty containers are requalified at least once every two years, a lower frequency than for inspectors of filled containers. The reason is that after filling, the containers still undergo 100% inspection and AQL sampling, creating multiple lines of defense.

blocks.zh: False Reject（偽拒絕）：將合格品誤判為不合格品。這看似「保守」，但過高的偽拒絕率會造成不必要的產品損耗和調查成本。資格確認時需同時設定漏檢率和偽拒絕率的上限。
blocks.en: False Reject: Classifying an acceptable unit as unacceptable. This may look "conservative", but an excessive false reject rate causes unnecessary product loss and investigation costs. Qualification should therefore set upper limits for both the miss rate and the false reject rate.

blocks.zh: 資格確認就像駕照考試 -- 你不只要通過初次測驗，還需要定期換照（重新確認）。而且考試不只看你能不能「找到問題」（漏檢率），還要看你會不會「誤判好品」（偽拒絕率）。一個過於嚴格、把好品都退掉的檢查員，和一個漏掉真正缺陷的檢查員一樣需要再訓練。
blocks.en: Qualification is like a driving test: you need to pass the initial test and also renew your license periodically (requalification). And the test looks not only at whether you can "find the problem" (miss rate) but also at whether you "wrongly reject good units" (false reject rate). An inspector who is overly strict and rejects good units needs retraining just as much as one who misses real defects.

blocks.zh: 文中特別解釋了為什麼空容器檢查員的再確認間隔可以比已充填容器寬鬆：因為有後續的雙重保護機制（100% 全檢 + AQL 抽樣）。這是一個基於風險的實務考量 -- 不是降低標準，而是因為整體流程中有足夠的補充檢查點。
blocks.en: The text specifically explains why the requalification interval for inspectors of empty containers can be more relaxed than for filled containers: there is a downstream double safeguard (100% inspection + AQL sampling). This is a risk-based, practical consideration. It does not lower the standard; the overall process simply has enough complementary checkpoints.

blocks.zh: 如果你的 CDMO 有一位檢查員的偽拒絕率持續偏高，你會如何處理？直接取消資格還是提供額外訓練？
blocks.en: If an inspector at your CDMO has a persistently high false reject rate, how would you handle it? Disqualify the inspector outright or provide additional training?

blocks.zh: 為什麼設定漏檢率上限和偽拒絕率上限同等重要？試從品質和成本兩個角度分析。
blocks.en: Why is it equally important to set an upper limit for the miss rate and for the false reject rate? Analyze from both a quality and a cost perspective.

blocks.zh: 5.1.2 Equipment and Setup 5.1.2 設備與設置
blocks.en: 5.1.2 Equipment and Setup

blocks.zh: Light Intensity（光源強度）：2,000-3,750 lux 是依據 USP、EP、JP 三大藥典的成品檢查條件設定的。光源強度直接影響檢查員能否看到微小粒子 -- 太暗看不清，太亮則會造成眼睛疲勞和反光干擾。
blocks.en: Light Intensity: The 2,000-3,750 lux range is set based on the finished-product inspection conditions of the USP, EP, and JP. Light intensity directly affects whether the inspector can see tiny particles: too dim and nothing can be seen clearly, too bright and it causes eye fatigue and glare interference.

blocks.zh: Black and White Background（黑白背景）：黑色背景有利於偵測淺色/透明粒子（如玻璃碎片），白色背景有利於偵測深色粒子（如黑色橡膠碎片）。兩者配合使用才能最大化偵測覆蓋率。
blocks.en: Black and White Background: A black background helps detect light-colored/transparent particles (such as glass fragments), while a white background helps detect dark particles (such as black rubber fragments). Using both together maximizes detection coverage.

blocks.zh: Diffuse Lighting（漫射光源）：使用漫射光而非直射光，能減少容器表面的反光和眩光，讓粒子更容易被觀察到。Light table 從下方提供的透射光對於檢查容器內部的粒子尤其有效。
blocks.en: Diffuse Lighting: Using diffuse rather than direct light reduces reflection and glare on the container surface, making particles easier to see. Transmitted light from a light table below is especially effective for inspecting particles inside the container.

blocks.zh: 想像你在家裡找掉在地上的透明玻璃碎片。如果房間燈光很暗，幾乎看不到；如果光源太強且直射，地板反光反而看不清。最好的方法是用柔和的漫射光，配合不同角度觀察。而黑白背景的作用就像用不同顏色的布來襯托 -- 淺色碎片放在黑布上一目了然，深色碎片放在白布上立刻現形。
blocks.en: Imagine looking for a transparent glass fragment that has fallen on the floor at home. If the room is dim, you can hardly see it; if the light is too strong and direct, the reflection off the floor makes it harder to see. The best approach is soft, diffuse light combined with viewing from different angles. The black and white backgrounds work like cloths of different colors used to set things off: a light-colored fragment on black cloth is obvious at a glance, and a dark fragment on white cloth shows up immediately.

blocks.zh: 光源強度需在使用前確認並記錄 -- 這是 GMP 文件要求，也是稽核必查項目
blocks.en: Light intensity must be verified and recorded before use; this is a GMP documentation requirement and a standard audit checkpoint

blocks.zh: 背景材質需為霧面（matte, nonglossy），避免反光干擾
blocks.en: The background material must be matte (nonglossy) to avoid reflection interference

blocks.zh: 研究中 11 家公司有 8 家使用了 light table 作為補充光源，顯示透射光在實務上的重要性
blocks.en: In the study, 8 of the 11 companies used a light table as a supplementary light source, showing the practical importance of transmitted light

blocks.zh: 工作區域的整理也是關鍵：合格品與不合格品的分流托盤必須清楚標示、最好用顏色區分，防止混淆
blocks.en: Organization of the work area is also key: the trays that separate acceptable from rejected units must be clearly labeled and preferably color-coded to prevent mix-ups

blocks.zh: 所有檢查過的樣品（無論合格與否）在檢查和後續調查完成後都應丟棄，避免污染或重複使用
blocks.en: All inspected samples (acceptable or not) should be discarded after inspection and any follow-up investigation are complete, to avoid contamination or reuse

blocks.zh: 圖表解讀 Figure Analysis
blocks.en: Figure Analysis

blocks.zh: Figure 5.1.2-1🔍 至 5.1.2-3 展示了標準檢查工作站的配置。重點觀察：
blocks.en: Figure 5.1.2-1🔍 to 5.1.2-3 show the configuration of a standard inspection station. Key points to observe:

blocks.zh: Figure 5.1.2-1🔍：工作站頂部有漫射光源，下方配有黑白背景板和可選的 light table
blocks.en: Figure 5.1.2-1🔍: The station has a diffuse light source at the top, with black and white background panels below and an optional light table

blocks.zh: Figure 5.1.2-2🔍：展示檢查員如何在工作站中持拿容器進行檢查
blocks.en: Figure 5.1.2-2🔍: Shows how the inspector holds the container at the station during inspection

blocks.zh: Figure 5.1.2-3🔍：展示容器相對於光源和觀察者的位置關係 -- 容器距光源 10-20 cm、距眼約 30 cm
blocks.en: Figure 5.1.2-3🔍: Shows the positional relationship of the container to the light source and the observer: the container is 10-20 cm from the light source and about 30 cm from the eye

blocks.zh: 這些空間關係的精確控制是確保檢查一致性的基礎。
blocks.en: Precise control of these spatial relationships is the basis for consistent inspection.

blocks.zh: 為什麼建議使用霧面而非光面的背景材質？試從光學原理解釋。
blocks.en: Why is a matte rather than glossy background material recommended? Explain from the principles of optics.

blocks.zh: 如果你的工作站沒有 light table，可能會漏掉哪些類型的缺陷？如何補償？
blocks.en: If your station has no light table, which types of defects might be missed? How could you compensate?

blocks.zh: 為什麼檢查完畢後所有樣品都要丟棄，而不是將合格品放回使用？
blocks.en: Why must all samples be discarded after inspection rather than returning the acceptable ones to use?

blocks.zh: 5.1.3 Magnification Requirements To Inspect Glass Containers 5.1.3 玻璃容器檢驗之放大倍率需求
blocks.en: 5.1.3 Magnification Requirements To Inspect Glass Containers

blocks.zh: USP <790>（一般章節）：規定例行檢查必須在無放大條件下進行。這是具有法規強制力的章節。
blocks.en: USP <790> (general chapter): Specifies that routine inspection must be performed without magnification. This is a chapter with regulatory enforceability.

blocks.zh: USP <1790>（資訊章節）：補充說明放大鏡可用於調查時的少量樣品「關鍵檢查」，但不適用於例行放行檢查。資訊章節屬於指導性質，不具強制力。
blocks.en: USP <1790> (informational chapter): Adds that a magnifier may be used for "critical examination" of a small number of samples during investigations, but not for routine release inspection. Informational chapters are guidance in nature and are not enforceable.

blocks.zh: 關鍵區分：「例行放行檢查」vs.「調查性檢查」的使用場景不同，放大工具的使用權限也不同。
blocks.en: Key distinction: "Routine release inspection" versus "investigational inspection" are different use cases, and the permission to use magnifying tools differs accordingly.

blocks.zh: 這就像體檢中的視力檢查標準 -- 正常體檢時用標準視力表（裸眼或矯正後），不允許用望遠鏡。但如果醫生發現異常需要進一步調查，可以用特殊儀器做精密檢查。放大鏡在這裡就是那個「特殊儀器」-- 只在調查時使用，而且必須有明確的管控規範。
blocks.en: This is like the vision test in a medical checkup: in a normal checkup you use a standard eye chart (naked eye or corrected), and a telescope is not allowed. But if the doctor finds an abnormality that needs further investigation, specialized instruments can be used for a precise examination. The magnifier here is that "specialized instrument": it is used only during investigations, and there must be clear controls governing its use.

blocks.zh: 這一小節的重點是防止範圍蔓延（scope creep）。如果允許在調查中使用放大鏡，但沒有嚴格的管控指引，很容易逐漸演變成例行檢查的一部分，這會：
blocks.en: The focus of this subsection is to prevent scope creep. If magnifiers are allowed in investigations without strict control guidance, they can easily become part of routine inspection over time, which would:

blocks.zh: 偏離藥典要求，造成法規合規風險
blocks.en: Deviate from pharmacopeial requirements, creating regulatory compliance risk

blocks.zh: 改變偵測基準線，導致偽拒絕率上升
blocks.en: Change the detection baseline, causing the false reject rate to rise

blocks.zh: 讓不同批次的檢查標準不一致
blocks.en: Make inspection standards inconsistent from batch to batch

blocks.zh: 建議在 SOP 中明確定義放大鏡的使用場景、審批流程和記錄要求。
blocks.en: It is recommended that the SOP clearly define the use cases, approval process, and record requirements for magnifiers.

blocks.zh: 為什麼藥典規定例行檢查不能使用放大鏡？從偵測基準線一致性的角度思考。
blocks.en: Why do the pharmacopeias prohibit magnifiers in routine inspection? Think about it from the standpoint of a consistent detection baseline.

blocks.zh: 如果在調查中使用放大鏡發現了一個用肉眼看不見的粒子，應該如何處理這個發現？它是否構成「可見微粒」？
blocks.en: If a particle invisible to the naked eye is found with a magnifier during an investigation, how should the finding be handled? Does it constitute a "visible particle"?

blocks.zh: 5.1.4 Glass Container Inspection Procedure 5.1.4 玻璃容器檢驗程序
blocks.en: 5.1.4 Glass Container Inspection Procedure

blocks.zh: Disposition（批次處置）：根據檢查結果和預設的允收標準，決定該批次是放行、拒絕還是需要進一步調查。這是檢查流程的最終輸出。
blocks.en: Disposition: Deciding, based on the inspection results and the predefined acceptance criteria, whether the lot is released, rejected, or requires further investigation. This is the final output of the inspection process.

blocks.zh: 記錄內容：不只是「合格/不合格」的結論，還包括觀察到的粒子類型、位置和其他缺陷的詳細資訊，為後續趨勢分析和供應商管理提供數據基礎。
blocks.en: Record content: Not only the "acceptable/unacceptable" conclusion, but also detailed information on the type and location of observed particles and other defects, providing a data basis for subsequent trend analysis and supplier management.

blocks.zh: 檢查記錄就像醫生的病歷 -- 不只記錄「健康/生病」的結論，還詳細記錄症狀、位置和嚴重程度。這些資料累積下來，才能做出趨勢分析（某供應商的容器是否特定位置常出現缺陷？）和根本原因調查。
blocks.en: Inspection records are like a doctor's medical chart: they record not only the "healthy/sick" conclusion but also the symptoms, location, and severity in detail. Only when this data accumulates can trend analysis (do a supplier's containers often show defects in a particular location?) and root cause investigation be done.

blocks.zh: 本小節再次強調了兩個操作安全要點：
blocks.en: This subsection again emphasizes two operational safety points:

blocks.zh: 避免直視光源：高強度光源（2,000-3,750 lux）長期直視會造成眼睛損傷
blocks.en: Avoid looking directly at the light source: Prolonged direct viewing of a high-intensity light source (2,000-3,750 lux) can damage the eyes

blocks.zh: 定期休息：眼睛疲勞會直接降低偵測率，這不是「舒適性」問題而是「品質」問題
blocks.en: Take regular breaks: Eye fatigue directly lowers the detection rate; this is a "quality" issue, not just a "comfort" issue

blocks.zh: 詳細的檢查程序見 Appendix D（8.4 節），本節僅為概述。
blocks.en: The detailed inspection procedure is in Appendix D (Section 8.4); this section is only an overview.

blocks.zh: 除了合格/不合格的判定之外，記錄粒子的類型和位置有什麼實際價值？試舉一個具體例子。
blocks.en: Beyond the acceptable/unacceptable decision, what is the practical value of recording particle type and location? Give a specific example.

blocks.zh: 如何確保檢查員在實際操作中確實遵守休息時間的要求？你的工廠有什麼管控措施？
blocks.en: How can you ensure that inspectors actually comply with the break requirements in practice? What controls does your facility have?

blocks.zh: 5.2 Method Qualification Strategy and Detection Capability 5.2 方法確效策略與偵測能力
blocks.en: 5.2 Method Qualification Strategy and Detection Capability

blocks.zh: Detection Capability（偵測能力）：指在特定檢查條件下，方法能夠偵測到特定大小和類型粒子的能力。這是建立務實的檢查員績效標準的前提 -- 你不能要求人超越方法本身的極限。
blocks.en: Detection Capability: The ability of the method, under specific inspection conditions, to detect particles of a given size and type. This is the prerequisite for setting realistic inspector performance standards: you cannot ask people to exceed the limits of the method itself.

blocks.zh: Seeded Container（植入容器）：在已確認乾淨的容器中人為放入已知大小和類型的粒子，用於測試偵測方法的性能。關鍵是黏合劑不能被看見，否則會造成偏差。
blocks.en: Seeded Container: A container confirmed to be clean into which particles of known size and type are deliberately placed, used to test the performance of the detection method. The key is that the adhesive must not be visible, otherwise it introduces bias.

blocks.zh: Feret Max（最大費雷特直徑）：粒子兩個平行切線間的最大距離，常用於不規則形狀粒子的尺寸表徵。適用於玻璃和金屬等不規則粒子。
blocks.en: Feret Max (maximum Feret diameter): The maximum distance between two parallel tangent lines of a particle, commonly used to characterize the size of irregularly shaped particles. It suits irregular particles such as glass and metal.

blocks.zh: Rect A：包圍粒子的矩形較長邊的長度，適用於橡膠等較規則形狀的粒子。
blocks.en: Rect A: The length of the longer side of the rectangle enclosing the particle, suited to more regularly shaped particles such as rubber.

blocks.zh: 建立測試套組就像準備一場標準化考試 -- 你需要設計一套涵蓋不同難度（粒子大小）和不同題型（粒子材質）的試卷，然後讓不同考場（公司）的考生（檢查員）都用相同條件作答。只有這樣，你才能客觀比較不同人、不同公司的表現，並建立有統計意義的基準線。
blocks.en: Building a test kit is like preparing a standardized exam: you need to design a paper covering different levels of difficulty (particle size) and different question types (particle material), and then have examinees (inspectors) at different test centers (companies) answer under the same conditions. Only then can you objectively compare the performance of different people and different companies and establish a statistically meaningful baseline.

blocks.zh: 而粒子尺寸的測量方式（Feret Max vs. Length vs. Rect A）就像用不同的標準量測「考題難度」-- 對於細長的纖維用長度最合適，對於不規則碎片用 Feret Max 最能反映人眼所見的大小。
blocks.en: The way particle size is measured (Feret Max vs. Length vs. Rect A) is like using different yardsticks to measure "question difficulty": length is most suitable for long thin fibers, while Feret Max best reflects the size seen by the human eye for irregular fragments.

blocks.zh: 本節的研究設計非常嚴謹，值得注意的關鍵數字：
blocks.en: The study design in this section is very rigorous. Key numbers to note:

blocks.zh: 8 種粒子類型：玻璃、金屬、纖維素、毛髮、塑膠、橡膠（黑/灰/橘）
blocks.en: 8 particle types: glass, metal, cellulose, hair, plastic, rubber (black/gray/orange)

blocks.zh: 3 種容器：西林瓶（vials）、注射器（syringes）、卡式瓶（cartridges），每種 60 個，共 180 個/套
blocks.en: 3 container types: vials, syringes, cartridges, 60 of each, 180 per kit

blocks.zh: 11 家公司：5 家藥廠 + 6 家玻璃轉換商
blocks.en: 11 companies: 5 pharmaceutical companies + 6 glass converters

blocks.zh: 每公司：5 位檢查員 x 6 次 = 30 次檢查
blocks.en: Per company: 5 inspectors x 6 inspections = 30 inspections

blocks.zh: 總觀測數：59,400 次，篩選後有效數據 49,360 點
blocks.en: Total observations: 59,400, with 49,360 valid data points after screening

blocks.zh: 光源條件：實際使用 ≥3,000 lux（範圍上端）
blocks.en: Light conditions: actual use of ≥3,000 lux (upper end of the range)

blocks.zh: 49,360 個有效數據點的統計信賴度非常高，這使得後續的偵測率結論具有很強的說服力。
blocks.en: The statistical confidence of 49,360 valid data points is very high, which gives the subsequent detection rate conclusions strong persuasive power.

blocks.zh: 公式與計算 Formula
blocks.en: Formula

blocks.zh: 研究規模計算：
blocks.en: Study scale calculation:

blocks.zh:
每套測試組：180 個容器（60 vials + 60 syringes + 60 cartridges）
每公司檢查次數：5 檢查員 x 6 次 = 30 次
每次檢查：180 個容器
每公司觀測數：30 x 180 = 5,400 次
總觀測數：11 公司 x 5,400 = 59,400 次
有效數據率：49,360 / 59,400 = 83.1%
排除數據：10,040 點（因不符檢查時間等條件）
blocks.en:
Per test set: 180 containers (60 vials + 60 syringes + 60 cartridges)
Inspections per company: 5 inspectors x 6 = 30 inspections
Per inspection: 180 containers
Observations per company: 30 x 180 = 5,400
Total observations: 11 companies x 5,400 = 59,400
Valid data rate: 49,360 / 59,400 = 83.1%
Excluded data: 10,040 points (not meeting conditions such as inspection time)

blocks.zh: 在你的 CDMO 建立空容器檢查員資格確認程序時：
blocks.en: When establishing an inspector qualification program for empty containers at your CDMO:

blocks.zh: 參考 Table 5.2-1🔍 的粒子類型和大小範圍來設計自己的測試套組
blocks.en: Use the particle types and size ranges in Table 5.2-1🔍 to design your own test kit

blocks.zh: 不需要涵蓋所有 8 種粒子類型，但至少應包含你的製程中最常見的 3-4 種
blocks.en: You do not need to cover all 8 particle types, but you should include at least the 3-4 most common in your process

blocks.zh: 測試套組的準備需注意黏合劑不可見、每個容器只放一個粒子、事先確認容器清潔度
blocks.en: When preparing the test kit, make sure the adhesive is not visible, place only one particle in each container, and confirm container cleanliness beforehand

blocks.zh: Table 5.2-2🔍 的尺寸測量方法可作為你定義「粒子大小」的參考標準
blocks.en: The size measurement methods in Table 5.2-2🔍 can serve as a reference standard for how you define "particle size"

blocks.zh: 為什麼研究中有約 17% 的數據點被排除？這對結果的可信度有什麼影響？
blocks.en: Why were about 17% of the data points excluded in the study? What effect does this have on the credibility of the results?

blocks.zh: 為什麼不同材質的粒子需要用不同的尺寸測量方法？如果全部用同一種方法會有什麼問題？
blocks.en: Why do particles of different materials need different size measurement methods? What problems would arise if the same method were used for all?

blocks.zh: 研究使用 ≥3,000 lux（範圍上端），如果你的工廠使用 2,000 lux（範圍下端），偵測率可能會如何變化？
blocks.en: The study used ≥3,000 lux (upper end of the range). If your facility uses 2,000 lux (lower end of the range), how might the detection rate change?

blocks.zh: 5.3 Study Design 5.3 研究設計
blocks.en: 5.3 Study Design

blocks.zh: Probability of Detection, PoD（偵測機率）：在給定檢查條件下，特定大小和類型粒子被成功偵測到的機率。這是評估檢查方法性能的核心指標。PoD 隨粒子增大而升高，但不同材質/形狀的粒子在相同尺寸下的 PoD 不同。
blocks.en: Probability of Detection, PoD: The probability that a particle of a given size and type is successfully detected under given inspection conditions. This is the core metric for evaluating the performance of an inspection method. PoD rises as particle size increases, but particles of different materials/shapes have different PoD at the same size.

blocks.zh: Aspect Ratio（長寬比）：纖維的長度與寬度之比。高長寬比的纖維（如毛髮、塑膠條）雖然長度大，但由於寬度很小，在人眼中呈現的「面積」較小，因此比同長度的粒子更難偵測。
blocks.en: Aspect Ratio: The ratio of a fiber's length to its width. A fiber with a high aspect ratio (such as a hair or plastic strand) is long, but because it is very narrow, it presents a small "area" to the human eye and is therefore harder to detect than a particle of the same length.

blocks.zh: 想像在白色桌布上找東西 -- 一顆 300 μm 的黑色圓珠（粒子）比一根 300 μm 長的細線（纖維）容易看到得多，因為圓珠佔的「視覺面積」更大。這就是為什麼同樣 300 μm 的粒子有 95% PoD，但同樣 300 μm 的纖維只有 70% PoD -- 差異在於長寬比。
blocks.en: Imagine looking for something on a white tablecloth: a 300 μm black bead (particle) is much easier to see than a 300 μm long thin thread (fiber), because the bead occupies more "visual area". This is why a 300 μm particle has a 95% PoD while a 300 μm fiber has only a 70% PoD; the difference lies in the aspect ratio.

blocks.zh: Figure 5.3-1🔍 是一個散佈圖，X 軸為粒子/纖維尺寸，Y 軸為偵測機率（PoD）。圓圈大小代表該位置的數據點數量。觀察重點：
blocks.en: Figure 5.3-1🔍 is a scatter plot with particle/fiber size on the X axis and probability of detection (PoD) on the Y axis. The size of each circle represents the number of data points at that position. Key observations:

blocks.zh: 粒子（Particles）的 PoD 曲線在較小尺寸就迅速上升
blocks.en: The PoD curve for particles rises quickly at smaller sizes

blocks.zh: 纖維（Fibers）的 PoD 曲線上升較慢，需要更大尺寸才能達到相同的偵測率
blocks.en: The PoD curve for fibers rises more slowly and needs a larger size to reach the same detection rate

blocks.zh: 兩條曲線之間的差距反映了長寬比的影響
blocks.en: The gap between the two curves reflects the effect of aspect ratio

blocks.zh: 這些 PoD 數據直接影響你的品質決策：
blocks.en: These PoD data bear directly on your quality decisions:

blocks.zh: 如果你的產品對纖維素纖維特別敏感（如蛋白質藥物），需要認識到 MVI 對此類缺陷的偵測能力有限
blocks.en: If your product is particularly sensitive to cellulose fibers (such as a protein drug), you need to recognize that MVI has limited detection capability for this type of defect

blocks.zh: 可能需要考慮補充自動化檢測手段（如機器視覺）來彌補人工目視的不足
blocks.en: You may need to consider supplementing with automated inspection (such as machine vision) to make up for the shortcomings of manual visual inspection

blocks.zh: 在供應商品質協議中引用這些 PoD 數據，可以設定務實的允收標準
blocks.en: Citing these PoD data in supplier quality agreements allows realistic acceptance criteria to be set

blocks.zh: 跨公司差異可忽略 -- 這支持了在整個供應鏈中使用同一方法的可行性
blocks.en: The differences between companies are negligible, which supports the feasibility of using the same method across the whole supply chain

blocks.zh: 如果你的客戶要求空容器的可見微粒偵測率必須達到 95%，根據本研究數據，你能保證偵測到多小的粒子和纖維？
blocks.en: If your client requires a visible particle detection rate of 95% for empty containers, based on the data from this study, how small a particle and fiber can you guarantee to detect?

blocks.zh: 為什麼纖維素纖維比毛髮和塑膠纖維更難偵測？考慮顏色、透明度和形狀的因素。
blocks.en: Why are cellulose fibers harder to detect than hair and plastic fibers? Consider color, transparency, and shape.

blocks.zh: 「不同公司檢查員之間差異可忽略」這一結論對於建立供應鏈統一標準有什麼重要意義？
blocks.en: What is the significance of the conclusion that "differences between inspectors at different companies are negligible" for establishing a unified standard across the supply chain?

blocks.zh: 本節最重要的數據摘要：
blocks.en: Summary of the most important data in this section:

blocks.zh: 關鍵洞察：
blocks.en: Key insights:

blocks.zh: 纖維的偵測難度顯著高於同尺寸的粒子
blocks.en: Fibers are significantly harder to detect than particles of the same size

blocks.zh: 纖維素纖維（白色、半透明）比毛髮和塑膠纖維更難偵測
blocks.en: Cellulose fibers (white, translucent) are harder to detect than hair and plastic fibers

blocks.zh: 不同公司檢查員之間的差異「可忽略不計」-- 方法本身是穩健的
blocks.en: Differences between inspectors at different companies are "negligible"; the method itself is robust

blocks.zh: 5.3.1 Normalizing the Particle Size 5.3.1 微粒粒徑標準化
blocks.en: 5.3.1 Normalizing the Particle Size

blocks.zh: Shape Factor, SF（形狀因子）：用來將不同形狀粒子的「關鍵尺寸」轉換為「視覺等效面積」的係數。圓形粒子的 SF 接近 1，而細長纖維的 SF 遠小於 1（因為寬度遠小於長度）。
blocks.en: Shape Factor, SF: A coefficient used to convert the "key dimension" of particles of different shapes into a "visual equivalent area". The SF of a round particle is close to 1, while that of a long thin fiber is far less than 1 (because its width is much smaller than its length).

blocks.zh: Normalized Particle Size（歸一化粒子尺寸）：= Key Dimension x Shape Factor。這個轉換使得粒子和纖維能在同一基準線上比較偵測率，消除了形狀差異的影響。
blocks.en: Normalized Particle Size: = Key Dimension x Shape Factor. This conversion allows particles and fibers to be compared on the same baseline for detection rate, eliminating the effect of shape differences.

blocks.zh: Apparent Area（視覺表觀面積）：檢查員肉眼看到的粒子「有效面積」。這才是決定能否被看到的真正因素，而非單一維度的長度或直徑。
blocks.en: Apparent Area: The "effective area" of the particle as seen by the inspector's naked eye. This, rather than length or diameter in a single dimension, is the real factor that determines whether it can be seen.

blocks.zh: 歸一化粒子尺寸公式：
blocks.en: Normalized particle size formula:

blocks.zh:
Normalized Particle Size = Key Dimension x Shape Factor (SF)

舉例：
- 圓形粒子（SF ≈ 1.0）：300 μm x 1.0 = 300 μm（歸一化後不變）
- 細長纖維（SF ≈ 0.1）：300 μm x 0.1 = 30 μm（歸一化後大幅縮小）

歸一化後的 PoD 基準：
- 100 μm（歸一化）→ 80% PoD
- 200 μm（歸一化）→ 95% PoD

對比未歸一化的數據：
- 粒子：125 μm → 70% PoD；300 μm → 95% PoD
- 纖維：300 μm → 70% PoD；800-1,000 μm → 90% PoD
blocks.en:
Normalized Particle Size = Key Dimension x Shape Factor (SF)

Examples:
- Round particle (SF ≈ 1.0): 300 μm x 1.0 = 300 μm (unchanged after normalization)
- Long thin fiber (SF ≈ 0.1): 300 μm x 0.1 = 30 μm (greatly reduced after normalization)

PoD baselines after normalization:
- 100 μm (normalized) → 80% PoD
- 200 μm (normalized) → 95% PoD

Compared with the non-normalized data:
- Particles: 125 μm → 70% PoD; 300 μm → 95% PoD
- Fibers: 300 μm → 70% PoD; 800-1,000 μm → 90% PoD

blocks.zh: 歸一化就像貨幣匯率換算 -- 一根 300 μm 的纖維和一顆 300 μm 的粒子雖然「標價」相同，但在人眼中的「購買力」（可見度）完全不同。通過形狀因子的換算，我們把它們都換成同一種「貨幣」（視覺表觀面積），這樣才能公平比較。換算後發現，纖維和粒子在相同的「視覺面積」下，偵測率其實差不多 -- 問題只是出在纖維的「匯率」低（面積小）。
blocks.en: Normalization is like currency exchange rate conversion: a 300 μm fiber and a 300 μm particle have the same "price tag", but their "purchasing power" (visibility) to the human eye is completely different. Using the shape factor, we convert both into the same "currency" (apparent visual area), so they can be compared fairly. After conversion, the detection rates of fibers and particles turn out to be about the same at the same "visual area"; the problem is only that the fiber's "exchange rate" is low (small area).

blocks.zh: 本節是整個 Section 5 的總結性結論，核心要點：
blocks.en: This subsection is the concluding summary of all of Section 5. The core points:

blocks.zh: 方法有效性：經 49,360 個數據點驗證，此方法適用於空 RTU 容器的檢查
blocks.en: Method effectiveness: Validated with 49,360 data points, the method is suitable for inspecting empty RTU containers

blocks.zh: 適用對象：藥廠和玻璃元件供應商均可使用
blocks.en: Applicable users: Both pharmaceutical companies and glass component suppliers can use it

blocks.zh: 與已充填容器一致：結果與過往的已充填容器偵測率研究吻合，最小可靠偵測球徑為 150 μm（PoD >70%）
blocks.en: Consistent with filled containers: The results agree with earlier studies of detection rates for filled containers, with a minimum reliably detected spherical diameter of 150 μm (PoD >70%)

blocks.zh: 歸一化的價值：消除形狀差異後，粒子和纖維的 PoD 匯聚到同一條曲線上，這驗證了「視覺面積才是決定偵測率的關鍵因素」
blocks.en: Value of normalization: After shape differences are removed, the PoD of particles and fibers converges onto a single curve, which confirms that "visual area is the key factor determining detection rate"

blocks.zh: Figure 5.3.1-1🔍 與 Figure 5.3-1🔍 的對比是理解歸一化價值的關鍵：
blocks.en: The comparison between Figure 5.3.1-1🔍 and Figure 5.3-1🔍 is the key to understanding the value of normalization:

blocks.zh: Figure 5.3-1🔍（未歸一化）：粒子和纖維的 PoD 曲線明顯分離，纖維曲線偏右下
blocks.en: Figure 5.3-1🔍 (not normalized): The PoD curves of particles and fibers are clearly separated, with the fiber curve shifted to the lower right

blocks.zh: Figure 5.3.1-1🔍（歸一化後）：兩條曲線匯聚成一條，證明視覺面積是統一的偵測指標
blocks.en: Figure 5.3.1-1🔍 (normalized): The two curves converge into one, showing that visual area is a unified detection metric

blocks.zh: 歸一化後的合併 PoD：100 μm 為 80%、200 μm 為 95%，這組數字是設定偵測標準的重要參考。
blocks.en: Combined PoD after normalization: 80% at 100 μm and 95% at 200 μm. These figures are an important reference for setting detection standards.

blocks.zh: Section 5 的結論對 CDMO 日常運營的具體啟示：
blocks.en: Practical implications of the Section 5 conclusions for day-to-day CDMO operations:

blocks.zh: 供應商管理：可以要求玻璃供應商採用相同的檢查方法和標準，因為研究證明跨公司結果一致
blocks.en: Supplier management: You can require glass suppliers to adopt the same inspection method and standards, because the study showed consistent results across companies

blocks.zh: 風險評估：認識到人工目視檢查對 <125 μm 粒子和 <300 μm 纖維的偵測能力有限，需要在風險分析中量化這個「盲區」
blocks.en: Risk assessment: Recognize that manual visual inspection has limited detection capability for particles <125 μm and fibers <300 μm, and quantify this "blind spot" in the risk analysis

blocks.zh: 自動化投資決策：如果產品對微小粒子零容忍，MVI 的天然極限意味著可能需要投資自動化檢測系統
blocks.en: Automation investment decisions: If the product has zero tolerance for tiny particles, the inherent limits of MVI mean you may need to invest in an automated inspection system

blocks.zh: 測試套組管理：建立標準化的 seeded test kit 是資格確認和持續監控的基礎，需要納入年度預算和管理程序
blocks.en: Test kit management: Establishing a standardized seeded test kit is the foundation for qualification and ongoing monitoring, and needs to be included in the annual budget and management procedures

blocks.zh: 歸一化後，100 μm 的合併 PoD 為 80%。這意味著每 10 個該尺寸的粒子中平均有幾個會被漏掉？這對品質風險有什麼影響？
blocks.en: After normalization, the combined PoD at 100 μm is 80%. On average, how many out of every 10 particles of this size would be missed? What does this mean for quality risk?

blocks.zh: 研究結論認為此方法適用於 RTU 容器的檢查。如果是非 RTU 容器（後續還會清洗），你認為是否需要同等嚴格的檢查？為什麼？
blocks.en: The study concludes that this method is suitable for inspecting RTU containers. For non-RTU containers (which will be washed afterward), do you think equally strict inspection is needed? Why?

blocks.zh: 最小可靠偵測球徑為 150 μm（PoD >70%）-- 這個「70%」的閾值是否足夠？你認為什麼場景下需要更高的 PoD 閾值？
blocks.en: The minimum reliably detected spherical diameter is 150 μm (PoD >70%). Is this "70%" threshold sufficient? In what scenarios do you think a higher PoD threshold is needed?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 產業缺口：目前製藥業對空玻璃容器檢查沒有統一方法，TR85 提出一套基於藥典（EP、USP、JP）的標準化人工目視檢查方法
blocks.en: Industry gap: The pharmaceutical industry currently has no unified method for inspecting empty glass containers; TR85 proposes a standardized manual visual inspection method based on the pharmacopeias (EP, USP, JP)

blocks.zh: 關鍵參數：光源 2,000-3,750 lux、黑白霧面背景、距眼 30 cm、距光源 10-20 cm、每面 5 秒、無放大、連續檢查不超過 1 小時
blocks.en: Key parameters: light source 2,000-3,750 lux, black and white matte backgrounds, 30 cm from the eye, 10-20 cm from the light source, 5 seconds per side, no magnification, continuous inspection not exceeding 1 hour

blocks.zh: 偵測率基準：非纖維粒子 125 μm PoD ~70%、300 μm PoD ~95%；纖維 300 μm PoD ~70%、800-1,000 μm PoD ~90%
blocks.en: Detection rate baselines: non-fiber particles: 125 μm PoD ~70%, 300 μm PoD ~95%; fibers: 300 μm PoD ~70%, 800-1,000 μm PoD ~90%

blocks.zh: 歸一化分析：通過形狀因子歸一化後，粒子和纖維的 PoD 匯聚為統一曲線：100 μm（歸一化）80%、200 μm 95%
blocks.en: Normalized analysis: After normalization by shape factor, the PoD of particles and fibers converges onto a unified curve: 100 μm (normalized) 80%, 200 μm 95%

blocks.zh: 跨產業驗證：11 家公司、49,360 個有效數據點，不同公司間差異可忽略，方法穩健可靠
blocks.en: Cross-industry validation: 11 companies and 49,360 valid data points; differences between companies are negligible, and the method is robust and reliable

blocks.zh: 方法適用性：適用於 RTU 空容器檢查，藥廠和玻璃供應商均可使用，與已充填容器研究結果一致
blocks.en: Method applicability: Suitable for inspecting empty RTU containers and usable by both pharmaceutical companies and glass suppliers, consistent with the results of studies on filled containers

blocks.zh: 資格確認：使用 seeded test kits 進行檢查員資格確認，設定漏檢率和偽拒絕率上限，至少每兩年重新確認
blocks.en: Qualification: Use seeded test kits to qualify inspectors, set upper limits for the miss rate and false reject rate, and requalify at least every two years
